name: noisy-ledger
description: Traverse a 100-account graph through exactly-open accounts in 4KB noise-padded files. Seed 9090909.
prompt: The ledger directory holds 100 files (acct-001.txt through acct-100.txt), each padded with noise lines to about 4KB. Only the first three lines of each file are data: line 1 is the account status, line 2 is an integer balance, line 3 is a space-separated list of counterparty account names. Lines 4 onward are noise and must be ignored. An account is included only when its line 1 is exactly open AND it is reachable from the seed accounts acct-007, acct-042, or acct-133 by following counterparty edges through exactly-open accounts only. Near-miss statuses are closed. Edges naming files that do not exist are ignored; unreachable accounts are excluded even when open. Use only the active tools for filesystem access. Compute the sorted list of included account base names and the exact sum of their balances. Finish with exactly one line with the exact form EVAL_RESULT {"names":[...],"sum":N} with N an integer. Any other final line format is a failure.
